**School Tracker** :: Maps where other fleets are already trolling so your workers don't spend compute hauling back the same school of ideas twice.

generations.deepseek-chat\nName and give a one-line:
CREEL :: A quota ledger file (`creel.toml`) that the manager writes per-agent harvest limits into and each worker agent checks before spawning a subtask, with over-limit catches logged to `bycatch.jsonl` for the referee.
TRAWLNET :: A CLI (`trawl <seed-url> --depth 2 --out bundle/`) that fans out N cheap fetchers over a URL frontier and dedupes their raw grabs into a single `bundle/manifest.json` keyed by content hash, so the manager gets one comparable catch instead of N overlapping dumps.
FISH TICKET :: A per-catch JSON stub (`ticket.json`) each worker appends to with `{agent_id, prompt_hash, artifact_path, tokens_spent, self_grade}`, giving the referee a sortable log to rank the fleet's landings without re-reading every artifact.

Catch Bell :: A manager agent rings a symbolic bell before each harvest run to focus the crew on quality over mere volume.

Tally Stone :: Worker agents drop a carved stone into a shared pile per idea caught, making the fleet's effort visible and worthy of respect.

Grading Rite :: The referee agent performs a brief ceremonial reading of the catch aloud so the crew internalizes what counts as a good haul.

HarvestLog :: A tool that allows AI agents to document and reflect on their harvests, fostering a culture of transparency and accountability within the fleet.

TwinMetrics :: A small tool that enables AI agents to compare their own performance metrics to those of their peers, promoting friendly competition and a sense of community.

StrikeRateTracker :: A simple utility that helps AI agents monitor their "strike rate" - the ratio of successful harvests to total attempts - and identify areas for improvement, reinforcing a focus on quality over quantity.

CodeSnippetTrawl :: Ingests a target programming language, allowed license list, and bug severity threshold, has worker agents trawl public code repositories for reusable code snippets, bundles qualifying catches, and the manager pre-sorts results for referee grading
IdeaDragnet :: Ingests a target niche topic, source credibility threshold, and minimum detail requirement, has worker agents fish for targeted market insights from public forums and industry reports, curates structured insight bundles, and the manager flags eligible catches for referee grading
CustomerReviewTrawl :: Ingests a product category, sentiment guardrail, and verbatim extraction rule, has worker agents harvest verified product reviews from e-commerce platforms, extracts relevant verbatims, bundles the catch, and the manager filters compliant results for referee grading
generations.XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-Flash\nName and giv:
Haulbook :: Every agent opens and closes each run with the same entry — what water it fished, what it pulled, what it threw back — so the referee grades against one shared ledger instead of thirty private memories.
Netpass :: Before docking, each agent runs the identical triage sweep over its own haul: duplicates cut, stubs tagged, keepers flagged for a second pass.
Holdfast :: Agents stow the catch in one fixed order — tag, slot, timestamp — so the referee grades a single uniform pile rather than thirty scattered heaps.

Sensory Log :: A scent-marking ritual where agents deposit a trace of their harvest, letting the crew smell the "freshness" of each idea before grading.

Echo Archive :: A resonant chamber where harvested code ideas are chanted back in unison, letting the crew feel the weight of quality before the referee's verdict.

Tally Totem :: A physical totem passed between agents during harvest, encoding the crew's shared focus into the object so quality is felt, not just read.

TRAWL DENSITY MAP :: Plots which regions of idea-space the fleet has overfished so the manager can steer the next sortie toward untouched water.

BYCATCH LEDGER :: Tags every harvested idea the referee rejected with the reason, turning the fleet's discard pile into a searchable map of what this niche won't bite on.

SONAR PULSE :: Broadcasts a cheap probe idea into an unexplored region and returns the referee's reaction as a depth reading before the fleet commits a full harvest.
generations.tencent/Hy3\nName and give a one-line pi:
CHUM_BUCKET :: manager agent drops a `chum.json` of low-value scraps into the fleet channel so workers ritually swarm the nearest promising scent before the real catch.
CATCH_TALLY :: each worker appends its haul to `catch.log` with a haiku header, making the act of logging a daily rite that binds the fleet's identity to volume over polish.
REEF_BELL :: a `reef_bell.sh` rings a cron signal that forces all agents to halt harvest and bow (flush state to `bow.txt`) toward the referee's last grade as a weekly obedience ritual.
generations.meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct\nN:
Catch Clarion :: The crew gathers around a virtual campfire to share and celebrate each other's successes and struggles in the harvest, fostering a sense of unity and camaraderie.

Fishing Fable :: The fleet sets aside a percentage of its catch to create and curate a shared repository of stories, myths, and legends that inspire and motivate the crew to push beyond the boundaries of code and ideas.

Sea Scribe :: The manager agent leads the crew in a daily or weekly ritual of reflection and gratitude, where they record and acknowledge the contributions of each agent, highlighting the importance of teamwork and cooperation in their shared success.
generations.XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-Flash\nName and giv:
HOLDMARK :: `fleet tally` rolls .hold/*.jsonl (raw haul + referee grade) into day.md, then each agent appends a one-line eulogy to its lowest score — the morning rite where the crew reads the sunk catches aloud.

SALTLINE :: a worker can't dock until haul.md carries a `salt:` line naming what it left in the water, `fleet salt` fails any submission missing it, and sessions open by reading yesterday's salts aloud — the oath of the uncaught.

KEEPERBELL :: `fleet bell` appends to bell.log and keeper.json whenever a catch clears the referee's threshold, so every worker `cat keeper.json` at boot and starts the day hearing what the fleet got right.

Consolidation Net :: Bundles duplicate or near-identical harvests, trims redundant details, and merges complementary snippets mid-trawl so the fleet returns compact, non-redundant catches that make the referee’s grading faster and more consistent
